notes: Fixed: uploading into a group could also drop an item into the first group. The group is now re-checked and must stay selected right before every upload
Changelog: older versions are now browsed page by page instead of all expanding at once
Redesigned the emergency update screen: step-by-step guide, scrollable What's new, Copy link and Check again buttons
Update links switched to refs/heads/main on GitHub for faster loading
Added RGB style: Solid or Gradient
Added RGB theme: the color smoothly cycles through the rainbow (idea by croweer)
Added Brightness and Pastel sliders for the RGB theme
Added emergency updates: outdated versions ask you to update and are locked until you do
Added automatic update check, no need to press Check for updates
Changelog in Settings now opens and closes with a smooth animation
Changelog in Settings now shows only the new versions; older ones are hidden behind a button
Added a sound volume slider in Settings (with a preview click)
Sound volume is included when you share your config code
